title: AniMapVerse social content request
description: One JSON object per file in tools/social-engine/content/queue/ (or an array of them passed to `npm run social:queue -- --from`). See docs/SOCIAL_AGENT_CONTRACT.md.

oneOf.title: characterJourney
oneOf.description: A character's journey across the world map: hook → map → animated route → key locations → CTA.

id.description: Optional content id "<template>:<anime>:<subject>[:<segment>]" copied from catalog.json. If present it must match the config.

status.description: Optional. Only "queued" is allowed: the pipeline owns every other state.

anime.description: World: catalog `anime` (internal slug); public URL slugs are accepted too.

variant.description: Editorial variant. REQUIRED to produce a new edition of a video already rendered (same content + locale).

hook.description: Opening line, ≤ 2 lines on a phone. Default: deterministic template.

cta.description: Closing call to action. Default: deterministic template.

durationSeconds.description: OMIT IT: the engine computes the length from the stops. If it must be explicit, copy the catalog `recommendedDurationSeconds` exactly; never invent it.

notes.description: Why this content was chosen. Stored, never rendered.

allowRerender.description: HUMAN OVERRIDE ONLY. Agents must not set it.

hookType.description: Hook category (copy it from catalog/next.json). Recorded in history for performance analysis.

hookId.description: Hook template id (copy it from catalog/next.json).

ctaType.description: CTA category (copy it from catalog/next.json); drives the per-network caption wording.

selection.description: How the growth selector picked this content (copy it from catalog/next.json). Omit for hand-written requests.

audio.description: Optional local royalty-free soundtrack inside tools/social-engine/audio/. Agents should omit it.

subject.description: Character: catalog `subject` (SEO slug, e.g. "itachi-uchiha"). Ids ("char-itachi") and unique short forms ("luffy") are accepted too.

segment.description: Part of a multi-part journey, copied from the catalog item (`segment`, e.g. "part-02"). Required for series, must be omitted for single journeys. Never invent it.

journey.description: Optional journey tuning. Omit it unless there is a precise reason.

highlights.description: Locations featured in the recap (ids or SEO slugs). Must be stops of the journey. Omit for automatic selection.
